fusions.name: Bowling Charge
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles toward the target and plows through, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Kicking Heel
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Tempo
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Gallop Rhythm
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, you regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. You move 6% faster.
